notes: Life skill ladders (12_Systems/systems.md section 5 and 5.3; crafting_v6_audit.md section 3.2). Ranks are parallel F to SSS tracks. Rank-up from commissionFromRank onward needs the XP AND a passed masterwork commission; until then the skill sits at the threshold with no loss. XP per craft = recipe xp (or defaultRecipeXpByRank of the recipe's lifeRank) times firstCraftMultiplier on a recipe's first craft, times trivialMultiplier when the recipe rank is trivialRankGap or more below the skill rank; never below minXp, never a penalty, no decay. Gather XP uses gatherXpPerNode by skill rank with the same trivial rule. Skill ids follow systems.md section 5 in snake_case; deferred skills have no content yet.
